lemma factorial_telescope (i : ℕ) :
    (i + 1) * Nat.factorial (i + 1) = Nat.factorial (i + 2) - Nat.factorial (i + 1) := by induction i with
    | zero => norm_num
    | succ i ih =>
      simp_all [Nat.factorial_succ, mul_add, add_mul, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
      <;> ring_nf at *
      <;> omega

/-- Every factorial is at least 1 -/

lemma factorial_ge_one (k : ℕ) : Nat.factorial k ≥ 1 := by induction k with
| zero => simp [Nat.factorial]
| succ k ih => 
  rw [Nat.factorial_succ]
  apply Nat.succ_le_of_lt
  exact mul_pos (Nat.succ_pos _) ih

/-- For any k, (k + 1).factorial ≥ 1 -/

lemma factorial_succ_ge_one (k : ℕ) : Nat.factorial (k + 1) ≥ 1 := by exact?

/-- Natural number subtraction: if a ≥ b then a - b + b = a -/

lemma nat_sub_add_cancel {a b : ℕ} (h : b ≤ a) : a - b + b = a := by omega

/-- Sum over range with telescope pattern -/

lemma factorial_n_plus_1_ge_one (n : ℕ) : Nat.factorial (n + 1) ≥ 1 := by exact?

/-- 1.factorial = 1 -/

lemma factorial_one_eq_one : Nat.factorial 1 = 1 := by norm_num
